project: FLL SPIKE Prime robots - program from VS Code over Bluetooth (USB fallback)
open_in_vscode: FLL.code-workspace (launcher only; .vscode/ holds all config). On open, tools/check_env.* runs and reports if setup has not been run.

platform_notes.macos: spike command = ~/.local/bin/spike (PATH line appended to ~/.zshrc if needed); venv python = .venv/bin/python; first BLE scan needs the Bluetooth permission dialog accepted; Bluetooth addresses are hidden - robots are matched by ble_name, so keep names distinct

acceptance: spike --help prints usage in a fresh terminal
spike discover lists a hub over Bluetooth (hub on, light blinking, SPIKE app closed)
spike run programs\hello_hub.py prints 'Hello from the hub' and exits 0
Ctrl+Shift+B in VS Code on an open program does the same

requirements.python: 3.12 (user install; newer risks bleak's WinRT bindings)
requirements.installers: winget (Python.Python.3.12, Microsoft.VisualStudioCode), user scope, no admin

never_install: any Hub OS 'upgrade' (1.8.149 is current; there is no Hub OS 3)
files_written_outside_folder: macOS/Linux: ~/.local/bin/spike, plus one PATH line in ~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc if ~/.local/bin was not on PATH (setup.sh)

ble_protocol.framing: COBS, delimiter 0x02, max block 84, XOR 3, trailing 0x02

hub_advertises_only_when: powered on, connected to nothing (SPIKE app included), not running a program

daily_commands.stay_connected: spike session   (then: run FILE / r / stop / quit)
